evidence.description: FIND-001 CONFIRMED CLOSED. REQ-012b defines attributeGenomeIdSol(ledgerRow, traceLines) as a PURE, TIMESTAMP-ONLY nearest-preceding-match join (tLine.ts <= ledgerRow.ts, take MAX such ts), explicitly stating NO market/task/mint field comparison. Rationale is independently grounded: sol-trade/run.sh:65-105 (read directly) runs franklin-trading start SYNCHRONOUSLY (blocking `timeout 600 ...`) and appends the live-pass trace line as the LAST step, and record-swap.mjs:44 only ever extracts/records the LAST swap signature per pass -- so 'at most one genome-linked line precedes at most one confirmed swap per pass' is a real, verified invariant, not an assumption. Edge cases explicitly cover: multiple preceding lines -> nearest/largest ts wins (not earliest, not blended); tie (ts equal) -> treated as <=, matching REQ-012's own contract; none preceding -> null (unattributed, REQ-013's 'no genome' path); multi-genome sequences -> each swap independently resolves to ITS OWN nearest-preceding genome_id, explicit no-misattribution-across-a-mutation-boundary clause. record-swap.mjs:19 (task = fixed constant 'jupiter swap round-trip') independently re-verified as the reason PM's market===task key cannot apply to SOL.

FIND-002 CONFIRMED CLOSED. REQ-013 now has an explicit 'EARS (accumulation field -- MUST)' clause binding realized_usdc to Number(row.net_usdc || 0), win-or-loss, and explicitly forbids summing row.earn_usdc alone. Independently re-verified against ground truth: skills/_shared/lib/ledger.mjs:11-37 deriveLine() computes net_usdc = round(earn_usdc - cost_usdc) and stores it on EVERY ledger row (including sol-trade rows, since record.mjs:18-24 routes ALL sources through the same deriveLine()); record-swap.mjs:43-45 confirms earn_usdc is WIN-ONLY (delta>0?delta:0, always 0 on a loss) -- so the spec's claim that summing earn_usdc alone would hide losses and let a net-losing genome falsely clear REQ-014's net-positive floor is factually correct, not speculative. Edge case + acceptance criteria now require a genome whose only counted rows are net-negative to yield a negative summed realized_usdc (not merely excluded rows).

FIND-003 CONFIRMED CLOSED. REQ-015 now carries an explicit 'EARS (reuse mandate -- MUST, same rationale as REQ-014)' clause requiring literal import-and-call of evolve.mjs's exported promote(genome, {canonicalPath, cwd}) UNCHANGED, with an explicit 'MUST NOT be authored' clause for a hand-written SOL-specific git-commit implementation, mirroring REQ-014's no-reimplementation mandate word-for-word in structure. Independently re-verified against evolve.mjs:169-195: promote() is exported (export function promote) and IS already parameterized by canonicalPath/cwd exactly as REQ-015 now states, and evaluatePromotion is likewise exported (evolve.mjs:132, export function evaluatePromotion) -- so REQ-014/015's reuse mandates are technically real and importable, not aspirational.
